rule: No number reaches the screen without a source. Cap/salary figures trace to the warehouse (nba_player_contracts) and the league constants; the Package-A payroll to the gate run; title odds to the model run, framed 'my model says' / hypothetical / estimates.

claims.claim: a normal mid-level shooter signed on top of the moves
claims.source: CORRECTED 2026-06-22: the slide previously claimed shedding Randle unlocks the 'bigger ~$8M MLE'. FALSE once a legal 14-man roster is counted. With Edwards/Gobert/McDaniels/Naz/Ayo/Joan/TSJ/Phillips/Jrue/rookie + 3 minimums to reach 14, the max MLE that fits under the first-apron hard cap is $6,422,588 -- essentially the $6,065,000 taxpayer MLE. So the usable shooter is ~$6M and the 'bigger MLE' framing was dropped. The real prize of shedding Randle is the apron TIER, not the MLE size.

claims.claim: full 14-man payroll after the trade -- under the first apron
claims.source: cap run, full 14-man roster (Edwards/Gobert/Jrue/McDaniels/Naz/Ayo/Joan/TSJ/Phillips/rookie $2,783,880 + ~$6M shooter + 3 minimums to 14): $208,677,532, $422,588 under the first apron ($209,100,000). Tight but under, and out of the second-apron zone. No trade exception absorbs Jrue, clean aggregation taking back less.

claims.claim: the same full roster if you DON'T trade Randle -- jammed in the second-apron zone
claims.source: cap run, same 14-man build but Randle $33,333,334 + DiVincenzo $12,535,000 instead of Jrue (and one fewer minimum slot): $218,387,746, only $3,612,254 under the second apron ($222,000,000). This is the tier the trade escapes: between the aprons = frozen picks, no aggregation, hard-cap handcuffs.

claims.claim: the trade's salary shed (the mechanic that drops the tier)
claims.source: Randle $33,333,334 + DiVincenzo $12,535,000 = $45,868,334 out; Jrue $34,800,000 in. Shed = $11,068,334. (The two full-roster landing spots differ by ~$9.7M, since trading 2-for-1 also frees one minimum roster slot.) This shed is what moves MIN from the second-apron zone ($218.4M) to under the first apron ($208.7M).

claims.source: Phase 2 dev_distribution_percomp.csv, mature career-years 4-6, faithful sub-class (rookie min <=600), seed 20260621. Honest tiers by impact: Rotation piece +0.3 to +1.7 = 12%; Real starter +1.7 to +4.0 = 18%; Two-way anchor (Gobert-level) >= +4.0 = 6%. CORRECTED 2026-06-22: the prior 12/12/12 was an artifact of equal-width cut points and inflated the elite-anchor tail; the real anchor bar (>=+4.0, near Gobert's +4.57) is a thin 6%.
